profile.headline: Web Developer
profile.summary:
I'm an accomplished IT Professional with experience in the financial industry seeking new opportunities.  Self-motivated with consistent high quality performance, I enjoy being part of a team as well as working independently. My strengths include effective project management and clear communication in technical and business environments. I enjoy sports, politics and spending time with my family.

Highlighted Skills

•	C#, XML, LINQ, SQL, XAML, ActiveReports, JSON
•	WPF, .Net, WCF (SOA), MVVM, ETL, SDLC
•	Microsoft Visual Studio, Microsoft SQL Server
•	PowerBuilder, Sybase SQL, TSQL
•	Pervasive Data Integrator
•	Microsoft SQL Enterprise Manager

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
CCS Medical 
Enterprise level medical supply software development utilizing ITMS Change Control software to document the development lifecycle including present changes in meetings. Experience with Medical Forms (PWO), Letters, Workflow, Billing, Supplies, Insurance with PowerBuilder and PL/SQL.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Website design with JavaScript framework on Vue.js, Vuetify and Google Cloud Platform. Enhanced SEO results with Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools for Bing/Yahoo. Check out the Majestics Booster Club website www.argylemajestics.org.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
American Heart Association (11/2017- 12/2017)
Provided analysis of Cardiovascular Center of Excellence (CVCOE) accreditation process.  Collaborated with subject matter experts, developed mind maps and flow charts for accreditation portal. Provided scope of work for American Heart Association to determine statement of work proposal for portal rewrite in Angular/.Net.

Greyhound (6/2016 - 8/2017)
I developed STEPS a non-customer facing mission critical accounting adjustment web application using ASP.NET, C#, Web API, JavaScript, JQuery, Bootstrap, AJAX and Kendo UI.  I migrated legacy PowerBuilder application to current version and ported database from Sybase to SQL Server. 

Nationstar Mortgage (3/2016 - 5/2016)
I implemented Google’s DoubleClick API for Nationstar’s data driven marketing campaign to increase ROI. This gave Nationstar power to know which search keyword purchases (i.e. Refinance) were most performant.

positions.title: Project Design Specialist
positions.description: Government Contractor assigned to Fiserv team - FDIC which required a Federal Security Clearance (Public Trust). Assisted in developing rich client accounting an application to facilitate bank closings - C# & WPF and was responsible for maintaining Excel & Access tools with SQL server backend.  Assisted in granting/revoking SharePoint permissions and SharePoint 2007 to 2013 conversion validation. Provided technical and software documentation.

company.name: FICS - Financial Industry Computer Systems, Inc

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Self-managed the transition of legacy PowerBuilder scripts to customized .Net programs using C#, WPF, LINQ and GrapeCity ActiveReports. Developed N-Tier software, designed modifications and provided implementation for customized programs. Tested thoroughly to ensure a high-quality and high-performance deliverable product. Designed, developed and implemented new feature requests by customers in several internal systems and 3rd party interfaces. Participated in daily scrums and coordinated with our development team within an Agile process. Communicated effectively with technical teams and business associates.

positions.title: Customized Programs/Conversion Manager
positions.description:
Managed the Conversion and Special Project department and filled roles as an ETL developer, software developer and Business Analyst/Project Manager.

Programmed custom programs including unique payment processing, billing statements, payment coupons, flat and XML file import and file creation modules. Managed projects including Conversions (ETL) and Customized Programs, concept to deliverable product. Interpreted customer/vender specifications, communicated, verified customer needs prior to software development and implemented thorough testing and timely delivery. 

Leadership Highlight - increased the number of Customized Programs actively maintained during my leadership of the department by more than three times. Each program was billed for initial development and monthly maintenance thereafter. Our sales records were set for new development and total billing increased yearly under my management. Over 90% of my day was spent on Software Developing while the remainder was managerial tasks.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description: I was responsible for the development and implementation of enhancements and modifications to all systems.

educations.fieldOfStudy: HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, Angular 5, AngularJS, Docker, Azure
